text:
Tara: New intake — model 'tempest-22b' wants onboarding. proposing preliminary priority slot next week, preliminary score 7/10. Needs quant + hallucination checks.
Mira: Posting quick MT-Bench snapshot in a sec, but initial QA looks promising for chat workloads.
Sam: Quick Q — main production surface? chat assistant + short-form summarization?
Tara: Yes, primary targets are chat + latency-sensitive summarization. aim to keep cost ~= 13b tier.
Jin: I'll take the hallucination probes and long-context tokenization checks. estimate 1-2 days for a reliable run.
Luis: Infra note: memory looks ok for int8 on our default serving config but we should test nf4/q4 variants. need numbers for Dedicated sizing.
Mira: Paste of MT-Bench head run: median quality 6.9, median latency 210ms/token (p4d-equivalent), hallucination ~8% on our evalset. Link: https://redwood.internal/evals/tempest-22b (placeholder)
Sam: Proposed quick scoring rubric for prioritization:
```
- Quality (weighted): 0-5
- Latency: 0-3
- Cost/ops: 0-2
- Total: /10
```
Tara: With current numbers I get: Quality 4.0 + Latency 2.5 + Cost 0.5 = 7.0/10. (hand-wave for now)
Jin: Plan: run quant sweep (int8, nf4, q4_0) and measure perf + quality delta. I'll schedule Mon morning.
opsbot: Job queued: quant-sweep-tempest-22b on eng-ml-runner #42 — ETA ~48h.
Mira: Noticed tokenizer edge-case: tokenization split variant causes truncated completions on some long prompts. patching tokenizer model, will re-run the failing subset after patch.
Sam: My red lines for canary: hallucination <5% on standard probe set AND no truncation regressions on long prompts.
Tara: Agree with Sam. If Jin's quant sweep shows <0.5 quality drop and Mira fixes tokenizer, we can do a small A/B canary.
Tara: Action items (short):
- Jin: run quant sweep & post logs (due Tue)
- Mira: tokenizer patch + re-run failing evals (due Mon EOD)
- Luis: estimate Dedicated footprint + cost delta for int8 vs base (due Wed)
- Sam: update roadmap slot (tentative Wed deploy window)

Tara: pinging @Mira @Jin for timeline confirmation.
Mira: on it, will update thread by EOD with patched evals.
Jin: GPU time booked Mon 08:00, will dump traces and perf tables to the run.
Sam: Thanks — if all green I'll schedule the canary run and brief ops for rollback. :thumbsup:
Luis: noting ops checkbox: variant routing + fallback to 13b if perf/quality degrades.
Tara: Cool. Keeping this short — we'll reconvene Thurs if there are surprises.
Mira: tagging results when available.
opsbot: Reminder: please fill out the model-intake form for tempest-22b so billing and auditing get auto-populated: https://redwood.internal/intake-form (bot)
Sam: nice. short follow-ups only after the sweeps.
Tara: thanks team, appreciate the quick responses.
